amendments.source_title: Government of Madhya Pradesh amendment to the M.P. Bhumi Vikas Rules, 2012: Rule 2(5)(c)
amendments.text:
Amendment dated 28 August 2026 to Rule 2(5)(c) of the Madhya Pradesh Bhumi Vikas Rules, 2012.
This amendment is later than the consolidated copy of the rules (06 March 2025).

On plots up to 500 square metres, construction or reconstruction that conforms with the existing land use specified in the approved Development Plan, and complies with the applicable norms, does not require separate development permission under Rule 2(5)(a).

Condition: conformity with the land use of the approved Development Plan and its norms is mandatory. Building permission from the local body is still required.

Source: public notice summarised at teamleaseregtech.com (article 59469), read 10 October 2026. Gazette notification number not stated in the source.
amendments.summary_en: Plots up to 500 sq m that conform to the approved Development Plan land use and norms no longer need separate development permission under Rule 2(5)(a). Building permission is still needed.
amendments.summary_hi: 500 वर्ग मीटर तक के भूखंड, जो स्वीकृत विकास योजना के भूमि उपयोग और मानकों के अनुरूप हों, उन्हें नियम 2(5)(a) के अंतर्गत अलग से विकास अनुज्ञा की आवश्यकता नहीं है। भवन अनुज्ञा फिर भी आवश्यक है।
